name: VC Dimension / Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension
proof: The full-domain projection is admissible by the sandwich theorem, and its VC dimension is $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$. Since $\mathrm{SCVC}$ minimizes over all admissible projections, $\mathrm{SCVC}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
